g.text: Under each key: left box = hold the C= key, right box = hold SHIFT. These are the characters printed on the front of the original keycaps.
Number keys: top word = CONTROL + key sets that color, bottom word = C= + key. 9 / 0 with CONTROL turn reverse video on / off.
Dark keys are the dark color on the original keyboard. Keys with nothing underneath have no front legend.
